I had a genuinely disappointing experience here, and I feel compelled to share it because it did not match the “premium” positioning at all.

From the start, the entire process felt rushed and poorly managed. The cleaning itself lasted around 20 minutes total, including Airflow, which is far below what I’ve experienced in other countries and clinics that position themselves as high-quality. I’ve had dental cleanings in places like Singapore and Switzerland, where appointments are thorough, careful, and patient-focused. This was the complete opposite.

The dentist gave the impression that simply being able to communicate in English was enough to establish credibility, but in my opinion, the technical skill and professionalism did not reflect that of a well-trained practitioner. The cleaning felt rushed, not particularly thorough, and more like something to get through quickly rather than perform properly.

What made the experience worse was the assistant’s handling during the procedure. She was extremely rough with the suction, to the point where it felt like it was being jabbed into my mouth multiple times and even hitting my gums. It created a tense, uncomfortable environment where I felt like I had to brace myself rather than relax during what should be a routine treatment. It didn’t feel careful or controlled — it felt careless.

For something marketed and priced as a premium cleaning, this felt more like an express, high-volume service. There was no real sense of attention to detail, no effort to explain or show results (not even a simple mirror check), and no indication that patient comfort was a priority.

I honestly don’t understand the positive reviews based on this experience. For me, this was one of the worst dental cleanings I’ve had in recent memory — rushed, rough, and not reflective of a professional or premium standard. It was not a gentle cleaning at all, in fact it felt violent. It felt like they just wanted to get it over and done with.—which they did.

I would not recommend this place.
